title: Twitch Follower Alert
blurb: The classic Twitch alert sound — the chime that interrupts every stream to announce a new follower. For streamers it's dopamine; for viewers it's Pavlovian 'someone just followed' recognition. Use it in edits about streaming, play it to prank streamers mid-game, or set it as a notification and feel like your phone is growing a community.
origin: The classic follower-alert chime from Twitch streaming culture.
